tickets.note: Now here's a guy: Sutton knows where the chalk is, and he keeps his feet in, and that's six — you throw it up and let him go get it.

tickets.name: Flea Flicker
tickets.note: Bernard is a red-zone target, and when they throw it up in the corner, he's the one coming down with it. He's got hands like a couple of buckets.

tickets.name: Trick Play
tickets.note: Here's Pitts, he chips the end, slips out, and he's wide open in the end zone: he's got glue on his gloves, that big fella.

tickets.name: Power Run
tickets.note: Tucker gets his looks down in the red zone, where the field gets small, and you need a guy who can go up and get it — he high-points it, and then it's his.

tickets.name: Counter Trey
tickets.note: Whap. Robinson wins on the back line of the end zone, and that's the line you wanna win on — he sells the in, breaks it out, all alone.

tickets.name: Toss Sweep
tickets.note: Boom. Andrews leaks out off the line down close, and nobody picks him up, boom — he rumbles down the seam like a mail truck.

tickets.name: Jet Motion
tickets.note: Hutchinson is a home-run hitter, and you don't need a short field when you hit home runs — he's got sticky hands.
